Something is wrong at OpenAI. Each model it has released since GPT-5.5 is smarter on paper and worse to work with, and GPT-6.1 Sol is the worst so far. OpenAI says 6.1 Sol is "built for complex refactors, deep codebase investigations, and long-running agents across apps." In my sessions it works for a day or more on things I never asked for.
